Manor

Villa in Si Sunthon
HomeSaleManor

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A phased development of single-storey three and four-bedroom pool villas in the Si Sunthon area of Thalang, divided into zones such as Manor, Arcadia, Luxe and Mori. Ownership for foreigners is by 30-year leasehold, renewable.

Manor: key facts

  • Manor is a single-storey pool villa in Si Sunthon, Phuket.
  • Units: 3–4 bedrooms, 345–359 sqm.
  • Construction status: completed; completion listed as Sep 2026.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿23,500,000.
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Thalang Hospital (2.6 km); HEI Schools Phuket (3.1 km); Robinson Lifestyle Thalang (3.4 km); Phuket International Airport (about 25 minutes, driving).

Facilities & amenities

  • 24/7 security
  • CCTV
  • Covered parking
  • Landscaped gardens
  • Swimming pool
  • Shuttle service (Papaya)
